text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the 4th corner and into the final 
straight!

text_block_list.name: Loves's Stream Member A
text_block_list.text:
"Go, Loves! Just a little more! Hang in 
there, hold on till the very end!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I hear them... I will definitely reward 
everyone's love!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I won't...! I won't surrender the Tiara to 
anyone!

text_block_list.name: Chrono & Loves
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaah! HAAAAAAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Chrono Genesis! Chrono 
Genesis finishes first!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... I-I did it...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"The Oaks"... The Queen of the Oaks will 
be... me...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I lost... Congratulations, Chrono-chan.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah... um, well, th-thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Why are you holding back?! You should be 
celebrating with everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because Chrono-san ran a race worthy 
of it.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I believe we ran a wonderful race. I think 
we were able to show the strength of our 
generation, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, you're right...! And her time is 
just as good as Ai-san's from last 
year...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"You will surely receive a fair 
evaluation"—was that it? Let us continue 
to polish each other's skills and strive 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So with that said, I'm getting my revenge 
at the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Loves's Stream Member C
text_block_list.text:
"Loves-chan... After all that hard work to 
finally reach the Oaks... *sniffle*... 
*hic*, waaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Loves's Stream Member A
text_block_list.text:
"Loves worked so hard... She gave it 
everything to return our love!"

text_block_list.name: Loves's Stream Member B
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Let's be grateful. For her immense 
love!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Aha... Thanks for the warm applause, 
everyone...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...I really wanted to deliver... the 
greatest love to everyone...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (Ah... right. It wasn't about breathing.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(The drama of the Oaks... was already 
being woven.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(A story where Love-chan, who overcame 
hardships alongside her fans, is the 
protagonist...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(If Love-chan is the protagonist—then what 
am I...?)

Even though she had claimed victory, 
Chrono Genesis was deep in thought with a 
serious expression.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...No, I was simply reflecting on the 
Genesis Method.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It seemed my analysis of the Genesis 
Factor was still rather naive this time as 
well...
choice_data_list:
Do you mean the bond between you and your 
fans, Loves?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes...
choice_data_list: But Chrono's the one who won.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But... it feels as though I won the 
race, but lost the battle.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"In the historical drama called the Oaks, 
Love-chan was the protagonist, and I 
was... just a supporting character."
choice_data_list:
That's not true! The star of the show is 
the Queen of Oaks—you!

That's not true! The star of the show is 
the Queen of Oaks—you!

text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow's newspapers and news broadcasts 
will have Chrono Genesis on the front 
page. Her name etched into the history of 
the Oaks, too."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose so, isn't it...?
choice_data_list:
Chrono ran a race worthy of the Queen of 
the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes... Thank goodness...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's also true that I felt... the 
power of drama... and history...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
In truth, Love-chan grew by listening to 
the voices of her fans. Their cheers gave 
her strength...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...The influence of the Genesis Factor... 
We'll need to re-evaluate it before the 
next Shuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, as I thought...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Even with a generous estimate of her 
future growth rate, the result at the 
Shuka Sho is..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A victory for Loves-chan, or 
Bouquet-san...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The difference in the Genesis Factor 
between me and those two will become a 
wall I cannot overcome—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (The Genesis Factor...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(...Love-chan has the bonds she's nurtured 
over the years with her community of 
fans.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Bouquet-san's desire to deliver 
victory... It's strong enough to support 
every stride of her running.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Gran-chan naturally possesses gifted 
talent and unshakable confidence...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (...Still, I...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Even when creating a historical drama, 
the Genesis Factor is indispensable.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The drama that fires up the fans only 
exists when there are factors worth 
considering...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Because of that, my historical 
predecessors... drew history and destiny 
itself to their side...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Still, as for me... I don't have that.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"I want to leave my hoofprints in 
history... Yet, if asked whether that 
dream could become an obsession..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...*Pant*. Trainer, I've finished the 
three sets.
choice_data_list:
Well then, let's cool down and wrap things 
up.
Well then, let's cool down and finish up.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, I was thinking of doing a bit more 
solo training..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"If possible, I'd like to increase my 
independent training not just today, but 
from now on as well... Would that be all 
right...?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I want to forge my own weapon...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I don't have the Genesis Factor like 
Love-chan and the others, so...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"I want to grow strong enough to make up 
for whatever I'm lacking...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...To become a presence that even history, 
even destiny itself would yearn to choose—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"I feel that is the only way for me to win 
the Shuka Sho...!"
choice_data_list:
Then... I'll put together an independent 
training routine for you.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you so much! I'm so sorry to 
trouble you...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I'll work that much harder, so...!

...I took on creating the menu because I 
was worried about leaving it to her.

Her impatience has been showing through 
recently. I suspect it's due to the future 
win rates calculated by the Genesis 
Method, but...
choice_data_list:
(Words would only be cold comfort 
anyway...)

text_block_list.text:
I need to find a way to dispel her 
underlying anxiety and help her regain her 
composure—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Nobody's coming, huh.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we can watch peacefully from 
here.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The fan voting results for the Takarazuka 
Kinen are—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
As expected, 1st place goes to Ai-san. The 
top ranks seem virtually unchanged from 
the interim results.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Lilie-san is holding onto 9th place too! 
Hehe, I hope she decides to run...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
! Gran-chan, that's amazing!! If you'd 
registered, you might've been able to 
run...!?
